text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet is striking poses in front of the mirror, all by herself...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's just you, Trainer...
Don't scare me like that.
choice_data_list: Sorry, you were really in the zone, huh?
Sorry, you were really focused there, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I was just deliberating on which pose
would bring out the best in that racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"When you win a race, it just wouldn't look right
if you didn't strike a cool pose for the photos, right?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Still, none of these feel quite right...
Hey, which one do you think is best?"
choice_data_list: Show off that you're “number one” with a sharp pose!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Showing off that I'm "number one"...
I see, that definitely sounds like me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, if that happens, the next problem
is figuring out what looks "Number 1!" the most."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Should I hold up a finger? Or point to the sky?
Maybe use my whole body...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, now I've got a new challenge to deal with...
I'm going to try a few things, so watch me from over there.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, I'm not letting you go until this is settled, okay?
You brought it up in the first place, so take some responsibility!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, I stayed with her until sundown as she deliberated over poses.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wha—hey!?
Was that an impression of me just now?! Are you kidding me?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm not childish like that!
I'm way more, like, mature and cool,
aren't I?!
choice_data_list: I thought they looked alike, though...
I thought they looked alike, though...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "We're not similar! We are definitely nothing alike!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Learning that she wasn't even conscious of her usual
pose made it a day of small discoveries.
